What is the problem?

We want to use an agent alongside a browser automation tool to generate and run
test scripts for our system integration testing on the upcoming platform upgrade.
The process is manual today and our team spends most of a sprint on it.

This aims to improve productivity, widen test coverage and speed up delivery.

Who are the users, and how many are affected?

The eight testers on our delivery team, and the two teams waiting on our release.

How have you tried to solve the problem so far?

We have scripted the most repetitive cases by hand. What am I allowed to use for
the rest — are agentic tools permitted under the current guidance?
